**FOUNDED IN 1933, THE PITTSBURGH STEELERS IGNITED A LEGACY THAT WOULD COME TO DEFINE GRIT, RESILIENCE AND THE SOUL OF STEEL CITY FOOTBALL. STEEPED IN HERITAGE, THIS UNIFORM CELEBRATES BOTH THE ORIGINS OF THE CITY AND STEELERS FOOTBALL.**  
**WE WILL DEBUT OUR NEW 1933 THROWBACK UNIFORM WHEN WE FACE THE GREEN BAY PACKERS IN WEEK 8 ON OCTOBER 26!**  
**THIS REIMAGINED HELMET DESIGN FEATURES A GRAY MASK AND MATTE YELLOW FINISH, HONORING A COMBINATION OF THE STEELERS' UNIFORM HISTORY WITH INSPIRATION FROM THE 1930s AND 1960s.**

# https://www.steelers.com/1933throwback/

**THIS REIMAGINED HELMET DESIGN FEATURES A GRAY MASK AND MATTE YELLOW FINISH, HONORING A COMBINATION OF THE STEELERS' UNIFORM HISTORY WITH INSPIRATION FROM THE 1930s AND 1960s.**  
**BLACK STRIPING PATTERN WITH BLACK-TRIMMED, OVERSIZED WHITE BLOCK NUMBERS BRING THE TEAM'S ORIGINAL UNIFORM TO MODERN LEAGUE STANDARDS.**  
**THE PITTSBURGH CITY CREST, THE CORNERSTONE OF THIS HISTORIC JERSEY, SITS ON THE LEFT CHEST HONORING THE TEAM'S HERITAGE AND CONNECTION TO THE STEEL CITY.**  
**OVERSIZED BLACK BLOCK NUMBERS FILL THE JERSEY BACK FOR A TWO-TONE BLACK AND GOLD COLOR COMBINATION.**  
**BEIGE PANTS EMULATE THE ORIGINS OF THE 1933 KHAKI UNIFORM WITH A REMASTERED NIKE DESIGN FOR MODERN ATHLETIC FIT.**  
####  
Experience Exclusive Steelers Content & Celebrate the 1933 Team with Custom Wallpapers!  
Download the Steelers Official Mobile App and take a closer look at the 1933 Throwback Uniform that will be worn in week 8 vs. the Green Bay Packers.
